scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; corepack enable pnpm 2>/dev/null || npm install -g pnpm@9.15.9'
scripts.prebuild: corepack enable pnpm 2>/dev/null || npm install -g pnpm@9.15.9 && pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile
scripts.build: pnpm --filter tiktok-luxury build && mkdir -p dist && cp -r artifacts/tiktok-luxury/dist/public dist/
scripts.build:all: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
